title: Outbound fetch restricted to an allowlist with redirect revalidation
source: Authored for the CodeReview benchmark corpus (expanded clean stratum), 2026-11-05
false_flag_note: A reviewer may flag the DNS resolution, the manual redirect loop, or the is_global check as paranoia. Each is load-bearing: only https on port 443 to an exact-match allowlisted host is permitted, URL credentials are rejected, every resolved address must be globally routable (which rejects loopback, RFC-1918, link-local and reserved ranges in one check), redirects are followed manually with the full validation re-run on every hop so a redirect cannot bounce the fetch to an internal target, and the hop count is capped.
